name: Biological Sciences: Neuroscience Track
notes: AP Biology (4/5) and IB Biology HL (6/7) earn general credit only - never major/minor requirements (encoded: apIbCreditExcluded).
UR courses must fulfill at least half the concentration requirements; ancillary-field courses are exempt (encoded: minPctFromHomeInstitution + per-group ancillary flags).
Maintain a 2.0 GPA within the major, excluding allied/ancillary field courses (minMajorGPA - informational: the app does not track grades).
Administered by the Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences; requirements sourced from the BCS neuroscience page (snapshot data-src/pages/bcs/bcs_undergraduate_.._neuro_requirements.html).
Twenty courses total; independent study credits (e.g. NSCI 395) may not substitute for any major requirement.
First-year organic students may substitute CHEM 172 (with CHEM 208 or CHEM 210W lab) for CHEM 132.

requirementGroups.label: Introductory biology I
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following: BIOL 110: Principles of Biology I (Spring); BIOL 110L: Principles of Biology I with lab (Fall)

requirementGroups.label: Introductory biology II
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus BIOL 111L: Principles of Biology II with lab (Spring)

requirementGroups.label: Genetics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: BIOL 198 & 198P: Principles of Genetics with Lab; BIOL 190 & 198P: Genetics: From Mendel to Molecules with Lab
requirementGroups.note: Judgment call: modeled as a one-slot choice (n_of), not an equivalency group - both feed the same downstream requirements.

requirementGroups.label: Biochemistry
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following: BIOL 250: Biochemistry (Spring); BIOL 252: Principles of Biochemistry (Spring)
requirementGroups.note: BIOL 198P and BIOL 250P labs are recommended but not required.

requirementGroups.label: Biology diversification elective (outside neuroscience)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students are required to take one biology diversification elective ... from within the biological sciences, but from outside the neuroscience curriculum. The diversification elective must be 200-level or higher and 4 credits.

requirementGroups.label: Neuroscience core
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: NSCI 201 & 201P: Basic Neurobiology with lab (Fall); NSCI 203: Laboratory in Neurobiology (Spring)

requirementGroups.label: Senior seminar
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: NSCI 301 or NSCI 302: Senior Seminar in Neuroscience (Fall or Spring)

requirementGroups.label: Neuroscience electives (4)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Neuroscience Electives (4 courses): NSCI 242; NSCI 243; NSCI 244; NSCI 245; NSCI 246; NSCI 247; NSCI 249; NSCI 250; NSCI 251; NSCI 252; NSCI 257; NSCI 280; BME 415; IND 447U
requirementGroups.note: NSCI 241 is no longer available (valid if previously completed); BME 415 on hiatus until 2026.

requirementGroups.label: General chemistry
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Both of the following general chemistry courses: CHEM 131: Chemical Concepts I with Lab; CHEM 132: Chemical Concepts II with Lab

requirementGroups.label: Organic chemistry I (one path)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following organic chemistry I courses: CHEM 203/207: Organic Chemistry I with Lab; CHEM 171/173: First Year Organic Chemistry I with Lab
requirementGroups.note: Alternate-rigor paths - also enforced by the orgo-sequence equivalency group (mixing paths is flagged).

requirementGroups.label: Statistics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following statistics courses: STAT 180 (AP credits acceptable); STAT 190; STAT 212 (no longer available)

requirementGroups.label: Additional allied field courses (4, from 2+ categories)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Four additional allied field courses, chosen from at least two of the following categories: Chemistry ... (full category lists on the BCS neuroscience page)
requirementGroups.note: NEEDS nuance: the two-category minimum and exact per-category lists are not auto-enforced; filter approximates the allowed departments.

upperLevelWriting.label: Two ULW courses (biological/natural sciences)
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: All biology majors must complete two ULW courses (per the shared UPBM requirement).
upperLevelWriting.note: Neuroscience is administered by BCS; ULW specifics follow the UPBM biology rule.
